title: Back by November First
十一月一日重新開張
paras: After eleven years, the floor of Maria Chen's shop was cracked and the walls had gone gray. She decided to {{renovate|renovate}} before the holiday season. "Six weeks, and we'll be done," promised Mr. Banks, the {{contractor|contractor}} she hired. His crew started the {{renovation|renovation}} in September. Maria carried all her rolls of {{fabric|fabric}}, the cotton and wool she sold to local tailors, into her garage and hung a sign on the door: "Closed {{temporarily|temporarily}}. Back soon!"
十一年過去，瑪麗·陳那間店的地板裂了，牆面也灰灰舊舊的。她決定在節慶旺季前整修。「六個星期就能完工，」她請來的承包商班克斯先生保證。九月，他的工班開始施工。瑪麗把賣給當地裁縫師的棉布和羊毛布料一捲捲搬進車庫，並在店門口掛上告示：「暫停營業，很快回來！」

In week three, the new floor {{tile|tiles}} arrived in the wrong color: green instead of white. The {{painter|painter}}, Joel, couldn't start the walls until the floor was done, so he waited in his truck. The {{completion|completion}} date slid from October 15 to the end of the month, and Mr. Banks admitted the job would now take {{considerably|considerably}} longer than he had promised.
第三週，新的地磚送來了，顏色卻送錯，要白色的卻是綠色。油漆工喬得等地板鋪好才能刷牆，只好坐在貨車裡等。完工日期從十月十五日拖到月底，班克斯先生也承認，這份工作要花的時間比他當初說的長上許多。

She had already mailed flyers announcing a {{reopen|reopening}} sale on November 1. That was her {{deadline|deadline}}. After that, holiday shoppers would go elsewhere. "Can't the work overlap?" she asked.
她已經寄出傳單，宣布十一月一日重新開幕特賣。那就是她的最後期限，過了那天，節慶的顧客就會去別家了。「工程不能同時進行嗎？」她問。

Mr. Banks thought about it. The next morning, the tile crew started at the back of the shop while Joel painted the front walls. On November 1, Maria unlocked the door at nine, and the first customer ran her hand over a bolt of blue wool and smiled.
班克斯先生想了想。隔天早上，鋪磚工班從店後方開始，喬則先刷前面的牆。十一月一日早上九點，瑪麗打開店門，第一位客人伸手撫過一捲藍色羊毛布，露出了微笑。
